# 08 — The seeding interview's day is stated rather than narrated

**What to build:** the day you poured a lifetime into the box is named for what it was rather than
narrated as a day you lived.

The seeding interview's inbox file holds a lifetime of Captures written in one sitting. Narrating that
as a day produces the most misleading file the system will ever write, on its first day. So the file
carries a marker, and the journal step skips composition for that day and writes a stated entry
instead, naming the day as the seeding interview and pointing at the inbox file.

Phase 12 writes the marker. This phase honours it, so seeding day does not need this code changed
later. The marker's shape is decided here and recorded, because phase 12 has to write the same thing
this reads.

No model call is made for a marked day. There is no judgement in "this was the seeding interview",
which is the same reasoning that makes the Health Canary code-composed.

**Blocked by:** 01 — Yesterday is written up as prose, and nothing is sent.
